episodes.name: Bite Club
episodes.plot: On the heels of getting captured in episode 111, Scott is desperate to escape and reunite with Hooch. With no way out, he realizes his only hope is to team up with Nuke, an angry pit bull who badly needs a friend. Laura rounds up every person and every dog she can find to rescue her brother, stop Walton, and pull off a daring rescue before it's too late.

A Deputy Marshal inherits an unruly dog who helps him solve crimes and investigate a family mystery.

overview.value: La vita del giovane e ansioso vice Marshal Scott Turner viene sconvolta quando eredita Hooch, un cane bavoso e diseducato. Il suo nuovo animale domestico è irritante, ma si rivela essere abbastanza bravo ad aiutare Scott a catturare i criminali, a trovare l'amore e forse anche a risolvere il mistero dell'ultimo caso del padre di Scott.
